comments: Tracklisting information comes from JDavidGarnett. The Gary Moore and Ozzy Osbourne live sets were repeated on the 22 March 1985 show.

transcript.text: Temper and pace. Deep Purple as they were back in 1969 from a compilation album that's just come out which is called The Harvest Story Volume 1, Art School Dancing.
Deep Purple there and ring that neck. Before that something from a new album which is called Power From The Universe.
It's out on Music For Nations by the Scots band called Battle Axe. They have the license to rock.
For the Rods, that's a track from their new album. It's out on Music For Nations. The album is called Let Em Eat Metal. That was the name of the track.
And before that you heard a Canadian band who've been together for some seven years. They are called Rapid Tears.
It's a 12-incher, four tracks on it.
Cry For Mercy is its title.
The track you heard was Eve Of Rock.
It's on the Chameleon record label, but I don't think it's available in this country.
Because the manager sent me that, all the way from Willardale in Canada.
Friday Rock Show from BBC Radio 1.
It is three minutes now to eleven o'clock.
Let's get into some real good music live.
Well, it was live at the time, and we can consider it to be live now.
First up we have Gary Moore.
Then we're going to have Ozzy Osbourne.
